_note: Report-specific mart for the cash flow forecast dashboard. Built from data/transformed. Illustrative data only.

cashFlowCategories.label: Operating Activities
cashFlowCategories.inflowWhatItRepresents: Cash generated by day-to-day operations — mining and data center revenue
cashFlowCategories.inflowDriver: Bitcoin sales + Data center customer payments
cashFlowCategories.outflowDriver: Mining costs + Other fixed operating costs

cashFlowCategories.label: Investing Activities
cashFlowCategories.inflowWhatItRepresents: Cash from investing activities, e.g. asset sales or equipment disposals
cashFlowCategories.inflowDriver: Not modeled in this MVP — always $0
cashFlowCategories.outflowWhatItRepresents: Cash spent building the data center
cashFlowCategories.outflowDriver: Construction payments (baseline × cost overrun, shifted by delay)

cashFlowCategories.label: Financing Activities
cashFlowCategories.inflowWhatItRepresents: Cash raised from lenders and investors
cashFlowCategories.outflowWhatItRepresents: Cash paid to lenders and investors, e.g. debt service or dividends
cashFlowCategories.outflowDriver: Not modeled in this MVP — always $0
